name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: if [ -f packages.txt ]; then sudo apt update && sudo xargs -a packages.txt apt install -y; fi; if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt; fi; echo 'Packages installed and requirements ready'
postAttachCommand: bash -lc 'cd /workspaces/mercadata && if ! lsof -iTCP:8501 -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null; then nohup python3 -m streamlit run main.py --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false >/tmp/streamlit.log 2>&1 & fi'
